name: Flesh Duplicate
clause: You may have ~ enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it has vanishing 3 if that creature doesn't have vanishing.

needs.proposedSignature: COVER_RULES.asEnters gains the anchored shapes /^(?:you may have )?~ enters? as a copy of (.+?)(?:, except (.+?))?\.?$/ satisfied by an asEnters entry of kind 'enter-as-copy' whose `optional`, `filter` and `except` match the printed words
needs.semantics: copy-clone ships `enter-as-copy` as an AsEnters (a replacement effect, deliberately not an ability), but no covers kind names it, so a script can never CLAIM the line it implements - every Clone-shaped card is unscriptable even when the declaration is exactly right. This blocks Flesh Duplicate independently of vanishing.
needs.clause: You may have ~ enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield

needs.proposedSignature: CopyException gains `vanishing?: number` (and the general form: AsEnters { kind: 'vanishing'; amount: number } + KeywordRegistry { vanishing: true }), plus a conditional exception form `exceptUnless?: { hasKeyword: Keyword }` for 'if that creature doesn't have vanishing'
needs.semantics: A permanent with vanishing N enters with N time counters; at the beginning of its controller's upkeep remove one; when the last is removed, sacrifice it. Flesh Duplicate needs it as a COPY EXCEPTION applied only when the copied creature does not already have vanishing (CR 707.9a).
needs.clause: except it has vanishing 3 if that creature doesn't have vanishing
